feed_items.headline: Boston Joins Lawsuit Against Federal Immigrant Housing Rules
feed_items.summary: Mayor Michelle Wu announced Boston is joining a legal challenge against new federal requirements that could cause over 500 local households to lose housing assistance starting Dec. 15.

feed_items.headline: AG Andrea Campbell Sues ICE Over Courthouse Arrests
feed_items.summary: Massachusetts Attorney General Andrea Campbell filed a lawsuit against U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement challenging warrantless arrests at state courthouses.

feed_items.headline: Boston Waterways Board Reconvenes After Over a Decade
feed_items.summary: Nine newly appointed members convened to establish safety, climate resilience, and public access protocols for Boston Harbor and the waterfront.

feed_items.headline: Crane Truck Strikes Overpass on I-495 in Chelmsford
feed_items.summary: One person suffered critical injuries Monday morning after a truck hauling a crane collided with a bridge along Route 495.

feed_items.headline: Patriots QB Drake Maye Sidelined With Fractured Fibula
feed_items.summary: Reports indicate New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye suffered a fractured right fibula and could miss the remainder of the regular season.

feed_items.headline: Mild Monday Gives Way to Pre-Thanksgiving Cooldown
feed_items.summary: After afternoon highs in the 60s, temperatures are forecast to drop into the 40s Tuesday through Thursday ahead of a potential Thanksgiving night rain system.
